company.name: Attarius Network
company.shortDescription: Attarius Network is the first and only all-in-one NFT ecosystem for the game industry. NFTs | Blockchain | GameFi
company.description:
Attarius Network — a time-saving and easy-to- go platform for game developers, players, and NFT creators, making the creation of web3 projects as simple as possible.
Attarius is creating a number of ecosystem products, including: Multichain Game API / Authorization interface / NFT cross-chain Wallet.
Game developers and players want games to run on cheap and fast networks, but also have the ability to sell NFT and FT on highly liquid networks. That's why Attarius Network uses NEAR as a core network, with the ability to transfer game assets to other networks.
With this type of functionality we close the gap between the proof-of-concept stage and a successful launch of the project.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $336,000, or 45.65% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,508,619 to $7,127,892, a 2.03x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
